description: This file 'commit-reach.h' declares functions, structures, and macros related to commit reachability and merge base calculations within a version control system, likely Git. It provides an interface for analyzing commit graphs, such as finding merge bases, checking descendant relationships, and reducing commit lists.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases
methods.description: Calculates common ancestors (merge bases) for two commits within a repository.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Calculates common ancestors (merge bases) for multiple commits.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many_dirty
methods.description: Calculates merge bases for multiple commits, with the caveat that object flags may no longer matter afterward.

methods.name: get_octopus_merge_bases
methods.description: Calculates merge bases for an octopus merge scenario involving multiple commits.

methods.name: repo_is_descendant_of
methods.description: Checks if one commit is a descendant of another within a repository.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge base set with a reference commit.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases with multiple reference commits.

methods.name: reduce_heads
methods.description: Reduces a list of commit heads by removing commits reachable from others in the list.

methods.name: reduce_heads_replace
methods.description: Replaces the list of commit heads with its reduced form to avoid memory leaks.

methods.name: ref_newer
methods.description: Determines if one object ID is newer compared to another.

methods.name: commit_contains
methods.description: Checks if a commit contains another commit, possibly utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach_with_flag
methods.description: Checks whether all commits in a list can reach commits with a specific flag, considering optional date and generation cutoffs.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach
methods.description: Checks whether all commits in one list can reach any commit in another list.

methods.name: get_reachable_subset
methods.description: Returns a subset of commits reachable from a set of starting commits, adding a reachability flag.

methods.name: ahead_behind
methods.description: Computes the ahead/behind counts of commits between two lines of history.

methods.name: tips_reachable_from_bases
methods.description: Marks tips reachable from specified base commits.

methods.name: get_branch_base_for_tip
methods.description: Finds the optimal branch base commit for a given tip among multiple reference commits.
